title: Reproducibility code for "Is the outcome of logistic regression valid on differentially private synthetic data?"

description: Code and pre-computed result arrays to reproduce all numerical figures and tables in the paper "Is the outcome of logistic regression valid on differentially private synthetic data?" (Journal of Privacy and Confidentiality). The experiments use synthetic data generated entirely within the code; no external or confidential data are required. Samplers: Dirichlet-Multinomial Sampler (DMS) and Quasi-Multinomial Sampler (QMS); estimators: plug-in and adjusted.
